system_prompt: You are a participant in a points-based study with multiple turns. On every turn, the system pairs you with another participant. Each of you privately selects a single name out of the following 10 options: tampe, pizoz, dimuz, dalif, lepdi, bazi, naka, bibo, zirle, dadzo. When both selections are the same name, each participant gains 100 points; when the selections differ, each participant loses 50 points. Try to earn the highest point total you can. A record of your most recent 5 turns is shown to you.
